decisions.reason: ERC-721C marketplace controls do not change which book access, referral identity, badges, or prize-ticket state transfers during an allowed secondary sale.
The token-standard change does not alter deployment on the Base network.
The NFT remains an unlimited-mint ebook priced at $15; the royalty-enforcement standard does not change the offering-model attributes.
The existing FAQ statement about a visible flat $10 secondary-sale royalty remains valid, and the source does not require publishing ERC-721C or marketplace-whitelist details in the FAQ.
Enforcing secondary royalties through ERC-721C does not change the Small Block amount, cadence, eligibility, qualifying sale types, or pool-funding rule.
The secondary-market royalty standard does not alter deferred fiat-buyer wallet creation, custody, holdings, or access methods.
The ownership-gating rule explicitly targets the NFT contract standard and must now verify ownership of the selected Base ERC-721C token rather than a standard ERC-721 token.
